user_query: trass gmail with term mgm avask canusa international tax registration within last 30 days

intent.goal: find gmail messages about MGM Avask Canusa International tax registration

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-30 days')
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%avask%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%avask%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%avask%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%canusa%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%canusa%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%canusa%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%international%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%international%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%international%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%tax%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%tax%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%tax%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%registration%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%registration%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%registration%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;
